_doc: Source manifest for the Azure Key Vault key-size policy family (Experiment 1, external EXISTENCE result). policy_provenance = third_party_logic_reimplemented: the decision logic (keyType selects the applicable minimum keySize threshold) is faithful to Microsoft-authored Azure built-in policy definitions, but re-expressed as a small evaluator here rather than executed through Azure Policy. We do NOT claim third-party executable, and we do NOT claim continuous C-witness prevalence (keySize is integer-quantized).
source_name: Azure built-in Key Vault policy family (key-size / key-type)
author: Microsoft
license: MIT (Azure/azure-policy samples); built-in definitions documented under Microsoft Docs terms
validated_idiom: keyType -> minimum keySize threshold (a category-conditioned numeric threshold x >= theta(s)).

candidate_policy_definitions.display_name: Keys using RSA cryptography should have a specified minimum key size
Key Vault keys should have an expiration date / symmetric (oct) key minimum size (operational policy family)
Keys using elliptic-curve cryptography should have the specified curve names
candidate_policy_definitions.note: EC policies constrain curve NAME (discrete), not a numeric key-size threshold -> NOT the numeric idiom; counted as a parsed-but-not-validated candidate.
